title: What If You Hiccuped for 68 Years? One Man Did

scenes.text: What if you couldn't stop hiccuping? One farmer hiccuped for sixty-eight years.
It began in June 1922, when Charles Osborne fell while hanging a 350-pound hog for butchering.
A doctor believed the fall damaged a tiny part of his brain stem that controls the hiccup reflex.
On average, he hiccuped 20 to 40 times every minute.
He still married twice, raised eight children, and kept his weight steady by blending his meals.
Then in 1990, the hiccups suddenly stopped, for reasons nobody knows. Guinness still lists it as the longest attack.

description:
What if you couldn't stop hiccuping?
